methodology: Read CLAUDE.md, REVIEW.md, and pipeline/segment_editions.py before review.
Recomputed every source slice from source_start/source_end and checked exact source text.
Checked boundaries, offsets, sourceText selector, deterministic IDs, year/header, publisher/location/pageCount, flags, and unresolved model decisions.
Applied Np. page-count rule; carrier page ranges and edition sublines are not separate edition nodes.
Escalated double headers, ca-year ID policy, collected carriers, and adaptation/work identity; no silent confirmation.
